title: Layout_04
slide_intent: Animate the image container to reveal supporting context while keeping the message anchored.
strategic_value: An expanding photograph can add movement to DB communication without moving the primary text block.
demonstration: On white, a logo and text remain on the left while an inset image on the right grows from a narrow strip; a white Schwelle sits along its lower edge.
practical_value: Choose an image-bearing module when the text needs a calm, stable background.

content_islands.name: Message anchor
content_islands.spec: Place the red DB logo and black text on the white left side.

content_islands.name: Image reveal
content_islands.spec: Grow the right image horizontally and retain the white bars at its lower edge.
